source_judgments: R851 explicitly supplies a first array-name(array-spec) pair and comma-led repetitions. Required per-item groups and optional double colon are retained rather than substituted with generic xyz-list grammar.
Array-name has the assumed R402 owner; it is not proof of positive rank. A qualifying zero-sized rank-one bound vector can declare rank0, while an ordinary zero-extent array still has positive rank.

A planned rank observation must query the actual declared object under its prior-property conditions, not a constructor or fixed-rank proxy. RANK-clause/C864, shape-category and source-order conditions retain their canonical owners.
R852 requires a parenthesized R828 intent-spec and nonempty dummy-name list. Explicit R1534/C1571 overrides assumed R402; an alternate-return asterisk is not that name.

INTENT permits data dummies and procedure-pointer dummies, not ordinary nonpointer dummy procedures. Genuine formal roles and complete interfaces remain prerequisites; nondummy contexts can also involve C1571.

Pointer IN association restrictions differ from valid operations on a live definable target. OUT state, default initialization, deallocation, finalization and zero-size/length definedness retain their exact subjects and order.
Undefined pointer association is not disassociation and cannot be queried by ASSOCIATED. Presence, allocation and lifetime are not inferred from zero-size or zero-length properties.

The p1 paragraphs define attribute routes, not local S runtime classifiers. Existing C815 deletion controls and canonical operation witnesses retain their actual occurrences, roles and owners; no automatic numbered-wrapper link is added.
